Senses.Note: Responsive verbal command is praised and tested, but the witnesses do not make it identical with realization.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (M/M59/M59n1540.xml). Dahui's General Discourses: Dahui Zonggao bears the exact headword. Dahui says the writer's command of language comes close to the Way without claiming he had reached it.

Occurrences.Kwic: 患聾者語言三昧他又不聞
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (T/T47/T47n1998A.xml). Dahui raises Xuansha Shibei's saying; Xuansha is the exact quoted utterer of the headword and Dahui the later quoter and commentator.

Occurrences.Kwic: 患聾者，語言三昧他又不聞
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X83/X83n1578.xml). Records Pointing at the Moon: Xuansha Shibei bears the exact headword. Xuansha asks how masters meet a deaf person who cannot hear their command of language.

Occurrences.Kwic: 以一切語言三昧作其佛事
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X64/X64n1260.xml). Extensive Record of Chan Master Zhongfeng: Zhongfeng Mingben bears the exact headword. Zhongfeng imagines a field using every command of language as its work.

Source record (J/J39/J39nB464.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Qianyan: Qianyan Yuanzhang bears the exact headword. Qianyan asks whether the inherited words amount to command of language, then counters that full effort cannot speak it.

Occurrences.Kwic: 行住坐臥、語言三昧是錯用心
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X69/X69n1359.xml). Recorded Sayings of Ying'an Tanhua: Ying'an Tanhua says that treating command of language as the task is misdirected effort.

Senses.Explanation: Command of language is mastery of responsive speech in public exchange. Dahui praises language that comes close to the Way and elsewhere raises Xuansha Shibei's deaf-person test; Xuansha asks how such command meets someone unable to hear. Zhongfeng imagines it functioning freely, while Qianyan questions whether inherited words amount to it. Ying'an supplies the limiting counterexample: treating command of language itself as the task is misdirected effort.
